title: New Heat Wave Could Intensify Wildfires in France and Spain
summary_full: Soaring temperatures in parts of France, Spain and Portugal could combine with dry conditions and strong winds to worsen the wildfire threat. It is the fourth heat wave to affect Europe since May.
